answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46680 Country: India Title: Can zakat be paid to Masjid Imam Question: The Imam sahib at our nearby Masjid is poor and needy. Can we pay our zakah to him so that he can meet his PERSONAL NEEDS? Answer ID: 46680 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1200/921/B=9/1434) Yes, you may help him from zakah money without any doubt. But you should pay zakah to him for Allah’s sake, not as salary of his imamat (leading salah). Also, it is not necessary to tell him that it is zakah; you may call it hadya (gift). It is sufficient to have intention of zakah in your heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
